IT Audit Analyst
Kestrel & Lowe LLP - Salt Lake City, UT (Hybrid)

About Kestrel & Lowe
Kestrel & Lowe is a professional services firm providing audit, tax and advisory services to clients across industries, including banks and credit unions.

The role
As an IT Audit Analyst you will evaluate IT general controls (ITGC) and application controls for our clients, supporting SOX and financial statement audits.

Responsibilities
- Plan and perform testing of IT general controls over access, change management and operations.
- Assess risks using frameworks such as COSO, COBIT and NIST.
- Document control testing clearly and track remediation of findings.
- Communicate issues to client stakeholders and engagement teams.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Accounting or a related field.
- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills; curiosity and a willingness to learn.
- Familiarity with SQL, Excel or data analytics tools is a plus. CISA a plus.

Kestrel & Lowe is an equal opportunity employer.
